brief: Print-on-demand streetwear label. The wordmark is the identity: a lowercase engineered skeleton where the u and n share one spine, ending in a coral full stop that lands like a punch. Must survive garment tags, social avatars and a 16px favicon.
criteria: Success: reads as crunchrr at a glance, distinct from streetwear clichés (bolts, flames, gothic), works one-colour and at 16px, seeds the storefront's design system.

concepts.name: Kinetic Wordmark
concepts.idea: Lowercase engineered skeleton set at an 8° kinetic lean; u and n share one spine; the coral full stop lands like a punch.
rationale: The name is the mark — identifier first, no bolt/flame clichés
Shared u/n spine is ownable; one stroke grid, one counter width
8° lean is baked into the masters — motion without italics clichés
Coral period is the only colour moment — the punchline

concepts.name: c. Monogram (companion cut)
concepts.idea: The wordmark's own c, enlarged, with a squared coral dot in the mouth — reads 'c.' at any size.
rationale: Compact carrier for avatars, tags and embroidery
Round c vs squared dot is the memory hook
Cut from the same skeleton — one voice, two scales

concepts.name: The Squeeze (alternate)
concepts.idea: Two offset plates compress a coral core — crunch frozen at maximum squeeze.
rationale: Least 'named' — kept as an alternate, not the lead

recommendation: Kinetic Wordmark as the primary identity, with the c. cut as its compact symbol — one skeleton at two scales.
next_steps: Confirm the direction (or ask for tweaks)
Trademark search before launch (professional check recommended)
Roll out to storefront header, favicon set and garment tags
